Pilot · Mauritania

Ahmedou Mohamed Lemine

Air Mauritanie, Nouakchott to Gran Canaria2007
Flight
Air Mauritanie, Nouakchott to Gran Canaria
Date
15 February 2007
Aircraft
Boeing 737
Location
Gran Canaria, Spain
Survivors
79 of 79 aboard

Soon after takeoff from Nouakchott, a lone gunman with two pistols hijacked the Air Mauritanie Boeing 737 and demanded to be flown to France. The captain, a 20-year veteran of the airline, said there was not enough fuel and headed for Gran Canaria. Realising the hijacker did not speak French, he used the public address system to tell passengers in French that he would brake hard on landing and then speed up, and asked women and children to move to the back. When the hijacker fell in the aisle, flight attendants threw boiling water from the coffee machine at him and about ten passengers held him down until Spanish police boarded. About 20 people had minor injuries from the braking; no one was killed.

Source: nbcnews.com/id/wbna17183946 ↗
